plugins.name: dev-kit
plugins.description: Development conventions toolkit — YAML standards and YAML skill

plugins.name: py-kit
plugins.description: Python coding conventions and scaffolding — feature-folder layout, function-first design, TypeScript-style typing, standards references with auto-injection metadata

plugins.name: html-kit
plugins.description: HTML/CSS/JS development toolkit — floating debug widget, logging conventions, FLOCSS + design tokens application

plugins.name: claude-kit
plugins.description: Toolkit for authoring Claude Code instruction files — CLAUDE.md, path-scoped rules, and skills

plugins.name: work-kit
plugins.description: Hook-based project lifecycle management — injects PR task context on every prompt and reminds task updates on stop

plugins.name: worktree-kit
plugins.description: Git worktree lifecycle management — create worktrees for PRs and keep VS Code workspaces in sync

plugins.name: guard-kit
plugins.description: Safety guards for dangerous operations — hooks that intercept git push/merge and other risky commands to enforce user confirmation

plugins.name: next-kit
plugins.description: Next.js 16 App Router implementation conventions split per file-type (1 file = 1 use case) — shadcn/ui + Tailwind + Drizzle + TanStack Query + Server Actions + Better Auth, with PreToolUse hook auto-injection (index.yaml + injection_rules.yaml) and PostToolUse TypeScript type-check

plugins.name: session-kit
plugins.description: Manages injection-token lifetime for other plugins: deletes the session's tokens each UserPromptSubmit (per-turn cache) and GCs stale tokens (1-day TTL) on SessionStart
